scope: apps/web/src/components/ui (#989, map #980). kind registry = shadcn base-nova registry item (upstreamItem names it; status pristine = hash must equal the vendored snapshot in scripts/ui-upstream-snapshots.json, deviated = registered divergence with reason). kind adapter = local composition over registry items or a repo-specific primitive (reason required). hash = sha256 over the comment-stripped, line-normalized file content (scripts/ui-normalize.mjs); comment-only edits do not move it, code edits always do. Scope is exactly this directory — domain-directory skins are ui-debt-gate/ui-drift-gate territory.

Rewritten as two-token color-mix(in oklch) washes on the file's own bracket idiom (upstream secondary/muted hovers); per-theme ratios derived from the upstream L targets (base 0.93 light / 0.30 dark, hover 0.88 / 0.35) against measured #988 token L values (card 0.9426/0.2553, primary 0.1706/0.9346): 2%/8% light, 7%/14% dark, |dL| <= 0.005 all four faces. No new token slot minted; zero consumers at registration (#1009 A1 consumes secondary/ghost only). #1244: removed the descendant button/a outline-none and gray focus ring so those controls use the global outline.
